title: transformers
summary: Hugging Face Transformers is a state-of-the-art library providing pre-trained models for various tasks across NLP, computer vision, and audio. It enables users to easily download, fine-tune, and deploy powerful models with high-level APIs or granular control. The library democratizes access to advanced AI, supporting research and production applications.

nodes.label: Developer / User
nodes.title: Human User/Developer
nodes.description: The primary actor interacting with the Transformers library to leverage, fine-tune, or deploy machine learning models for various tasks.

nodes.label: High-Level Task Pipelines
nodes.title: Task-Oriented Pipelines
nodes.description: Provides simplified, high-level APIs for common tasks like text classification, translation, or image recognition, abstracting away model and data processing complexities.

nodes.label: CLI Model Serving Tools
nodes.title: Command-Line Interface for Serving
nodes.description: Offers command-line utilities for deploying and serving models via an HTTP API, supporting features like continuous batching and quantization for efficient inference.

nodes.label: Pre-trained Model Architectures
nodes.title: Diverse Model Architectures
nodes.description: A vast collection of state-of-the-art model implementations for NLP, computer vision, and audio, ready for loading, fine-tuning, or direct use.

nodes.label: Advanced Generation Utilities
nodes.title: Text Generation Control
nodes.description: Provides comprehensive functionalities for text generation, including various decoding strategies (greedy, beam search, sampling) and continuous batching for efficient inference.

nodes.label: Data Preprocessing & Tokenization
nodes.title: Input Data Preparation
nodes.description: Tools for converting raw data (text, images, audio) into numerical formats suitable for model input, including tokenizers and feature extractors.

nodes.label: Model Conversion & Optimization
nodes.title: Model Lifecycle Management
nodes.description: Utilities for converting models from other frameworks, optimizing them (e.g., quantization), and managing their lifecycle for deployment and efficiency.

nodes.label: External System Integrations
nodes.title: MLOps & Fine-tuning Integrations
nodes.description: Connects the library with external MLOps tools for experiment tracking (WandB, DVCLive) and provides utilities for parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).

groups.label: User Interaction & Tasks
groups.title: User Entry Points & High-Level Tasks
groups.description: Provides direct interfaces for users to interact with the Transformers library, including high-level task-specific pipelines and command-line tools for model serving.

groups.label: Core Models & Generation
groups.title: Model Architectures & Text Generation
groups.description: Contains the definitions of various state-of-the-art model architectures and advanced utilities for controlling the text generation process.

groups.label: Data Preparation
groups.title: Input Data Preparation
groups.description: Handles the transformation of raw input data (text, images, audio) into numerical formats suitable for model consumption, ensuring compatibility and efficiency.

groups.label: Model Lifecycle & Optimization
groups.title: Model Conversion, Optimization & Integrations
groups.description: Tools for converting models from other frameworks, optimizing them for efficiency (e.g., quantization), and integrating with external MLOps platforms for enhanced workflows.
